from scipy.stats import pearsonr
D=pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
xs=['nitrogen_ppm','phosphorus_ppm','potassium_ppm','soil_ph','irrigation_mm','seed_density','mulch_depth_cm','biochar_g','fungicide_ml','shade_pct']
for x in xs:
 m=smf.ols(f'yield_kg ~ {x} + C(farm)',D).fit()
 print(x, 'coef',round(m.params[x],3),'p',m.pvalues[x], 'r2',round(m.rsquared,3))
print('\ncorrelations')
print(D[xs].corr().round(2).to_string())
